title: ACL tear,
most people blame a hard hit —
the real cause is how you land
Prevent it (and re-tears) the right way

items.name: It's Rarely Contact — It's the Landing
body: About 7 in 10 ACL tears happen with
no one touching you at all —
just a hard cut, pivot, or landing

items.name: Cutting, Landing, Sudden Stops
body: the list — sports with quick turns.
quads let the knee cave inward.

items.name: Protect It First — Don't Push Through
body: Rest the knee, ice it, and keep it
raised above heart level for 48 hours.

items.name: Get It Checked Within Weeks, Not Months
body: raises the odds of meniscus damage.

items.name: Train the Muscles That Back Up the Ligament

closing.headline: It was never really about toughness.
closing.tip: Most ACL tears are non-contact — it's about how the knee lands, not who hit it.
closing.cta: Knee ever buckled and swelled fast? Get it checked before you play again.
